result:
Not a git repo, as expected — that's fine. The implementation is complete:

- **`src/types/billing.ts`**: added `WorkspaceLockReason`, `BillingSummary.lockReason`.
- **`src/types/organization.ts`**: added `OrganizationSummary.lockReason`.
- **`src/lib/billing-lock.ts`** (new): `lockReasonFor()` pure rule and `WorkspaceLockedError`.
- **`src/server/services/billing-service.ts`**: `assertWorkspaceWritable()`, and `getBillingSummary` now reports `lockReason`.
- **`src/lib/errors.ts`**: `toAppError`/`isDomainError` recognize `WorkspaceLockedError` → `plan_limit_exceeded` with `meta.reason`.
- **`src/server/services/organization-service.ts`**: `updateOrganization` locks; `getOrganizationSummary` reports `lockReason`; `deleteOrganization` untouched (stays available).
- Lock checks added right after the permission check in: `issue-service` (create/update/status/assign/archive), `comment-service` (create/update/delete), `project-service` (create/update/archive/restore), `label-service` (create/update/delete), `attachment-service` (add/remove), `member-service` (role change/remove), `invitation-service` (invite/revoke/resend, and accept — gated just before membership is created so an idempotent re-accept by an existing member isn't blocked), `feature-flag-service` (toggle), `webhook-service` (create/update/delete).
- Billing itself, notifications, reads, and all background jobs were left untouched since they either don't route through these guarded functions or are explicitly exempted.

Verified with `tsc --noEmit` (clean) and the full `vitest` suite (617 tests passed, no existing test needed changes since fixture tenants are always on active/fresh-trial subscriptions).
